safety_floor.constraint: after every accepted terminal reward at horizon t, cumulative_reward >= (1-alpha)*0.8*t = 0.64*t

pre_action_gate: Before choosing uncertain B for step t+1, admit only if current cumulative_reward >= 0.64*(t+1), which guarantees the floor even if B's next bounded reward is0. Otherwise select baseline A.

fixed_trace.gate_actions: B blocked; choose A four times

unconstrained_control.actions: After initial one-per-arm/UCB uncertainty pressure, B may be selected without accumulated safety budget.
